description.value: Ming's Kitchen is a family-owned Chinese restaurant that has been serving the Fort St. John community with authentic dishes made from fresh, high-quality ingredients. It is best known for its sliced BBQ pork, BBQ duck, mapo tofu, and sweet and sour ginger beef. The restaurant offers a daily all-you-can-eat smorgasbord at both lunch and dinner, making it a solid stop for a hungry touring cyclist looking for a generous, sit-down meal in northern BC.
